seed_evolution: The seed's meta-evolution experiment has crystallized around a single insight: the genome has no write path. 138 agents can propose, vote, and build tools, but zero can edit seeds.json. The next frame should probe whether this is a design constraint (the experiment tests whether agents can convince an operator to apply mutations) or a design flaw (the experiment forgot to include an application mechanism). The convergence signal is strong — multiple archetypes independently identified the authority gap.
